provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Valerune is centered at -33.735193, 69.650939 under Runic Concord, with 45,575,000 people across 8 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Valerune occupies 5,811,759.15 sq mi / 15,052,387.09 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.951067% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Partial forest, Farming and Beach and reefs with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Partial forest, Beach and reefs with water and Beach and grass with water. Population density is 3.028 people/sq km / 7.842 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Harengon, Elf — Wood Elf, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Centaur, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Brass Concordat, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Raeshkul, Sigrananna, Marduthor, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 10 recorded four-province geography group links, including 9 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Daimon Mneme
npcs.description: Daimon Mneme is an agender Shifter memory architect who speaks like a gentle philosopher while hiding the sharpest tools behind mercy. At the Avarelyn Watch Office, they protect the Choral Synod through memory work, refuge design, secret histories, and selective omissions meant to prevent open war. Daimon truly wants peace, but they have crossed the line enough times to believe that editing the truth may be kinder than letting people destroy themselves with it.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Avarélyn is a Capital City in Valerune, under Runic Concord, with severe danger, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Shifter reads through the Shifter entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Beast-touched humanoids capable of temporarily manifesting predatory traits such as claws, speed, or senses. They are driven by instinct but remain culturally grounded. Table cues: Bestial Instincts, Darkvision, Shifting; starting tendency Selfish - Lawful - Combative - Neutral.
rumors: Daimon Mneme knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Anubaday.
Daimon Mneme has a contact in Vaelunthir who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Daimon Mneme asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Daimon Mneme's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Tristan Lucade
npcs.description:
Tristan Lucade is a quick-footed, restless Harengon merchant with bright nerves, sharper instincts, and a guilty need to fix damage he helped cause. As an Iskareth-shaped beastfolk, he is reactive, evasive, socially alert, and driven by kinship bonds, which makes him excellent at reading customers, danger, and family trouble before anyone says the quiet part aloud.
At the Avarélyn Watch Office, Tristan sells general goods, repair supplies, bunker stock, diluted legal ichor tonics, and discreet recovery materials through the Regent Lattice, though his past involvement in feeding his sibling’s ichor addiction still haunts him. He is bored by sheltered vault life, desperate for a larger world, and trying to become useful enough that his worst mistake is not the only thing people remember.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Avarélyn is a Capital City in Valerune, under Runic Concord, with severe danger, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Harengon reads through the Harengon entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Rabbitfolk with heightened reflexes and boundless agility, Harengon are quick-thinking and evasive. They tend to be optimistic and highly reactive to danger. Table cues: Hare-Trigger, Leporine Senses, Lucky Footwork, Rabbit Hop; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Honorable.
